blocks.text: TEHRAN — President Donald Trump confirmed on Tuesday that the United States launched strikes on Iran, as Tehran warned no one would benefit from a return to war. It came as US voters prepared to cast their ballots in midterm elections that threaten Trump’s grip on power. But Trump played down speculation he was preparing to resume bombing Iran once the polls were out of the way. “We seem to be getting everything we want,” Trump told Britain’s Financial Times newspaper on Tuesday.
